name: What types of fire pits does AKN Design Group include in outdoor living projects?

mainEntity.name: What types of fire pits does AKN Design Group include in outdoor living projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group integrates various fire pit styles into comprehensive outdoor living designs. We offer options ranging from built-in gas fire pits with stone surrounds to custom wood-burning fire features that complement your landscape architecture. Our focus is on crafting a durable, aesthetically pleasing feature that enhances your outdoor entertaining space. The choice depends on factors like desired fuel type, aesthetic preference, and how you envision using the space for gathering.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates various fire pit styles, from built-in gas to custom wood-burning, into outdoor living projects to enhance your entertaining space.
